description: Run a Collector by slug with a semantic input (see list_collectors for each collector's inputSchema and example). Short runs return the rows inline; long runs return 202 with a run_id + statusUrl — poll with collector_run_status. Results are billed per delivered row (never for failures). Set `async` true to force background execution.

async.description: Force background execution and return a run_id to poll

input.description: Input fields matching the collector's inputSchema (e.g. { keyword: 'dentist', location: 'Austin, TX', max_results: 20 })

name: run_collector
